title: Concurrency, locks and lanes
routing: Is this about two things running at once and who goes first: a race between processes or transactions (createLock, withOwnerLock, db.findForUpdate / upserting: true, find-then-create, upsert or unique-violation catches), ordering in-process writes (createSerializedQueue), capping parallelism (getConcurrency, resolveAll, Promise.all over many items), newest-wins jobs (claimLane / watchLane, makeSupersedingJob, SupersededError), singleton jobs (makeSingletonJob), a recurring timer (heartbeat instead of setInterval), or debouncing a backend-hitting input (useDebounce / useDebouncedCallback)?
